# ScienceDaily

> > Science news and research summaries covering health, medicine, biology, technology, and scientific discoveries from leading research institutions worldwide.

ScienceDaily aggregates and publishes breaking research news from universities and scientific institutions, translating peer-reviewed studies into accessible summaries across disciplines including molecular genetics, medical research, public health, neuroscience, and technology innovation.

## Key Topics

- cell division and chromosome distribution
- checkpoint kinases and molecular genetics
- cancer research and epidemiology
- premature birth and infant mortality
- racial and gender health disparities
- brain anatomy and neuroscience
- anxiety disorders
- microtubules and spindle apparatus
- centrosome and kinetochores
- neonatology and maternal-child health
- extremely low birth weight survival
- tobacco use and health outcomes
- public health statistics
- biomedical engineering innovations

## Health and Medicine Research

- [Black Baby Girls More Likely To Live When Born Very Premature](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2006/01/060103183741.htm): University of Florida research examining racial and gender disparities in premature infant survival rates and outcomes
- [Smoking Cigarettes, Cigars, Pipes Or Using Snuff Or Chewing Tobacco Does Not Cause Brain Cancer, Yale Study Shows](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2001/05/010510072748.htm): Yale University epidemiological study finding no association between tobacco use and brain cancer risk

## Neuroscience and Brain Research

- [Brain Anatomy Differences Found That Predispose Patients To Anxiety Disorders](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2007/05/070510115420.htm): Universitat Jaume I discovery of neuroanatomical variations associated with anxiety disorder susceptibility

## Molecular and Cell Biology

- [Let's Divide: How Daughter Cells Get Their Share Of Genetic Material](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2006/10/061027184057.htm): Max Planck Institute research on chromosome distribution mechanisms and checkpoint kinases during cell division

## Optional

- [Undergraduates' Invention Makes Handguns "Childproof"](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2000/05/000512121136.htm): Johns Hopkins undergraduate engineering project developing mechanical safety device for handguns
